ruling: - **R35. The global CLAUDE.md loads only what each session needs.** Owner 12:38 CST Nov 11: "im wondering whether i properly keep claude.md's just at the repo level and claude-settings level as its parent and no where further". Read 12:39 CST: the levels are right (global, repo, path-scoped rules in .claude/rules). The global file holds 3,890 words on every turn of every repo, and its size check counts lines (108 of 200), not words. Owner 12:40 CST: "yes that's fine it would need my sign off (the actual results of the review) but just marking it as an item for review is good to dos onow". 1. A read-only audit maps each global section to the repos and session roles where it matters. 2. The owner signs off the results before any section moves. 3. A lane moves the signed-off sections to path-scoped rules or skills, and the size check counts words too. Home: lint/check_claude_md_size.py; rule tokens-folder-rules-load-by-path.
